# 六藝綱目

## Authors / Editors
- 舒天民 (元朝) 撰
- 舒恭 (元朝) 注
- 人物 (明朝) 注

**Editions:** WYG

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A short Yuán-period educational handbook (2 *juàn*) on the Six Arts of the *Zhōulǐ* Bǎoshì office: *lǐ* (rites), *yuè* (music), *shè* (archery), *yù* (charioteering), *shū* (script), *shù* (mathematics). Cataloged in *xiǎoxué* by the Sìkù as a *fùlù* (appendix) — the only Yuán-period educational handbook in the *xiǎoxué* division. Format: the headings are versified into 4-character rhyming lines (*sìzì yùnyǔ*) — i.e., a memorable mnemonic for students — drawn from Zhèng Xuán's [鄭玄](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%84%AD%E7%8E%84) *Zhōulǐ* commentary. The author Shū Tiānmín supplied the verse-headings (the *gāng* — outline); his son Shū Gōng provided the principal commentary (the *mù* — itemisation); the Yínxiàn fellow-townsman Zhào Yízhōng provided supplementary annotations (the *fùzhù*). The book is methodologically sound on the *xiǎoxué* essentials but flawed on *liùshū* doctrine: the section on *zhuǎnzhù* takes 反 (倒首為反, 亾 之乏 [should read 𢎟 = 𠂉], 尸 as side-人, 匚 as side-凵) as *zhuǎnzhù* — the Sìkù *tíyào* points out these are *huìyì* and *xiàngxíng* respectively, not *zhuǎnzhù*. The *jiǔshù* section, however, supplies useful supplements to Zhèng Xuán's commentary and Jiǎ Gōngyàn's *shū*. Front-matter prefaces by Zhāng Zhù 張翥, Hú Shìzuǒ 胡世佐, Jiē Hóng 揭汯, Liú Rénběn 劉仁本; postface by 舒睿 dated *wùshēn* (1368, Hóngwǔ 1).

**Abstract**

The *Liùyì gāngmù* is a short Yuán-period educational handbook on the *Zhōulǐ* Bǎoshì Six Arts. The work has only marginal Old-phonology content (its *xiǎoxué* category is justified by its treatment of *liùshū* and *jiǔshù*) — placed in the Sìkù as a *fùlù* (appendix) to the *xiǎoxué* division. The text is by three hands: the *gāng* (4-char rhymed outlines) by Shū Tiānmín [舒天民](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%88%92%E5%A4%A9%E6%B0%91); the principal *zhù* by his son Shū Gōng [舒恭](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%88%92%E6%81%AD); the *fùzhù* by Zhào Yízhōng — who, the Sìkù *tíyào* deduces from the absence of mention in the 1364 prefaces and the 1368 postface, is a Míng-period addition to the work. The Sìkù *tíyào* finds the *liùshū zhuǎnzhù* discussion methodologically erroneous (mis-identifying *huìyì* and *xiàngxíng* graphs as *zhuǎnzhù*) but credits the *jiǔshù* work as a useful supplement to Zhèng Xuán's [鄭玄](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%84%AD%E7%8E%84) *Zhōulǐ* commentary. *notBefore* = c. 1340 (mid-Yuán, the author's *fl.*); *notAfter* = 1364 (the *jiǎchén* printing).
